checks.text: An ordinary shopper can start a made-to-order job
A shop account can start one too

shots.caption: An ordinary shopper on the made-to-order form
A stranger is asked to sign in first, because a job has a chat, a price and money to follow

notes: A stranger is sent to sign in first. The job needs a name, a chat and a payment trail, so "everyone" here means every kind of account.
did: As an ordinary shopper, opened the made-to-order form. Then did the same as a paikari shop and as a stranger.
